trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for earning every other trophy in the game, so there is no separate task to chase. Work the roadmap in order and it pops the moment the last trophy lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing as the story presents it; it unlocks on its own and cannot be skipped or missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, meditate at Jason's house — that first meditation spot is the one thing in the game that may be missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission. The last meditation spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after the Coffee Break mission in this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. Story trophies like this one unlock automatically, so just keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Bank vault robberies open up around an optional mission in this chapter, so keep an eye out for them while you play.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission. After it ends you return to free-roam, and everything needed for the 100% checklist is still available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when the story offers it. It is a story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you play.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. No extra preparation is needed; finishing the mission is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission when it appears in the story. Like the other mission trophies, it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission in the story. It unlocks by playing the main missions in order.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops as soon as the mission is finished.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission, a Chapter 5 story mission. Keep playing the main story and it will come.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist. It is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — and you only need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Everything on it is still reachable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida. You do not need all of them — 300 count toward 100% completion — so skip the ones that frustrate you and move on.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample one of every activity type the game offers — racing, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges also count toward the 100% checklist, so work them in the post-story cleanup stage and repeat a challenge until the gold time or score lands.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each Top Fun location. Learn the course on a first run, then race it cleanly; every location's win counts toward the 100% checklist too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races around Leonida. Each race only counts the first time you win it, so spread out across race types and locations instead of repeating one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is also one of the activity types for Master of None, so try it early and come back for the win once you know how the reeling works.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one game on it. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia when his missions appear.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands stay available after the story, so you can clean this up in stage 4.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Check the map for his marker between story missions and after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others — each count, and every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Do it during the story when his marker appears, or in the post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play as Jason for it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. This is the one possibly missable trophy: the first spot, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1, right after the Down to Earth mission when Lucia is at the house in the morning. Do it before leaving Chapter 1. The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting strand and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Bret's strand is Jason-only, and his quests count toward the 100% checklist, so do not leave them to the very end.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, but only 15 are needed for 100% completion, so you can leave the hardest sets unfinished and still finish the checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations around Leonida. It is a pure grind, so fold it into your exploration: WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new instead of saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. You only need 70 of 80 for 100% completion, so pick the easiest ones first and skip the hardest challenges entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a four-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape together until the heat dies down. A fast car and open countryside make the escape far easier than the city streets.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — so keep the level alive and move fast from one shop to the next. Plan a short route through three nearby shops before you start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning vehicles with the camera counts toward the 100% checklist too — 200 of 277 are needed there — so scan everything you pass while exploring.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus when at least five enemies are in front of you and take all five down before it ends. Pick a busy fight with grouped enemies and save beforehand so you can retry it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to Vice City International Airport and leave by an unscheduled route — steal a plane and take off without following the normal departure. Expect wanted attention the moment you do it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble with it. The description is a joke about the heat inside the tank — the trophy is about using the Rhino in combat, so drive it into a fight and start firing.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without any detection. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards' sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five of the eight bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring a four-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway before you crack the first one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape the wanted level that follows. Trucks run set routes, so watch for one, hit it fast, and have a getaway vehicle parked nearby.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida until the map is fully explored. It pairs naturally with the collectible hunts, so sweep the map while you chase cards, WAiNK spots and vehicles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which ones you have hit, since the trophy needs the full set.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — just visit the beach bar and take the drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight out through the glass of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style the description nods to. Pick a showroom, line the car up, and smash out through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game through to the end. The follow-through is the point — play the full game, not just one throw.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is tied to a partner activity with a wide audience — play the relevant partner content with Jason and Lucia together and the trophy will pop when the moment lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice and live with it. The trophy marks a decision point in the story, so it unlocks by playing through and choosing — there is no way to miss it by playing normally.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something once, then succeed on the second try — the description says the second time is the charm. If a story moment or challenge goes wrong the first time, go back and clear it on the next attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Stumble into one of Leonida's strange encounters — the kind of moment that leaves you asking what just happened. Explore the odd corners of the map and investigate anything out of place.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock targets over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Find a quiet stretch of road with pedestrians and line the swing up as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts over the course of the game. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so keep laundering them as you earn them instead of letting them pile up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida. It adds up naturally over a long playthrough — clothes, weapons, food and vehicles all count — and you can top it up late by buying something big.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available in the game. Save up for them through the story and the money trophies, and check the property listings whenever you have cash to spare.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you find while exploring instead of hunting for rare models.
